```plato

//==
// # Mesh attributes
//
// Named data channels layered over a base mesh: normals, UVs, colors,
// weights, tangents. A channel's storage length is dictated by its domain
// (per-vertex, per-face, per-corner, per-undirected-edge, or uniform). Channels
// are parallel arrays; they never alter the base mesh's connectivity.

// Which mesh element an attribute's values attach to: one value per vertex,
// per face, per face-vertex slot (allowing seams and hard edges), per
// undirected edge, or a single value for the whole mesh.
type AttributeDomain = PerVertex | PerFace | PerCorner | PerUndirectedEdge | Uniform;
```
